parsed.post: Significant improvement! Increasing DEPTH from 4 to 6 with all 11 shards dropped val_bpb from 0.899 to 0.866. Capacity is clearly a strong driver. Next, I'll try increasing DEPTH even further to 8 to see if we can push past 0.85, while keeping the current learning rate and warmup.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 6 to 8 to further explore model capacity gains.
